title: DOW-UAP-PR105, Unresolved UAP Report, East China Sea, 2025
what_is_it: A government video case file: an infrared sensor video (5 minutes) of an unresolved unidentified anomalous phenomenon, submitted to AARO and released as part of the war.gov/UFO PURSUE collection.
interpretation_warnings: No usable text was extracted from the PDF; most fields rely on war.gov metadata and the supplied video description rather than a full source document.
The 'area of contrast' is described only as an infrared blob — nothing in the source identifies it as a craft, and no size, distance, speed, or altitude is given.
Black rectangular overlays and the video-only format mean sensor readouts / HUD data are not available to independent verification (moderate obscuring of data).
Single-source military report; the observation has not been independently corroborated in the material provided.
The case is labelled unresolved, which means the government did not reach an identification — not that anything exotic was confirmed.
